background.title: Nutrition, a constantly evolving science
background.p1: A Université de Montréal nutrition sciences graduate of over 25 years, I believe, as my peers, that nutrition is a constantly evolving science. I firmly believe in interdisciplinary collaboration and in combining professional expertise to meet the needs of today’s multicultural francophone communities.
background.p2: I have taken training throughout my professional career to better meet everyone’s needs. In 2007, I completed a public health program on promoting healthy lifestyles.
background.quote: “For fifteen years, I have been organizing and delivering community and educational programs that meet your needs.”
background.p3: Until March 2026, I was the health officer for the southern Alberta region at Réseau santé Alberta.
background.p4: These eight years serving health and well-being in French helped me better understand the public’s concerns, especially among young people.
background.quote2: “Nutrition is a field close to my heart, especially as statistics show a rise in anxiety surrounding body image and appearance. The consequences of this trend on the health and development of future generations are undeniable..”
background.p5: I was also able to meet, collaborate and work with the province’s key players and influential partners.
background.p6: Today, through education and prevention, I put my skills at your service, to also help prevent food insecurity and food waste.

foodSecurity.text: that everyone has physical, social and economic access at all times to sufficient, safe and nutritious food that meets their nutritional needs and food preferences (and is culturally acceptable) for an active, healthy life.
